source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: prepare_ffi now destroys a created context when either configured security rule fails. Init also destroys and nulls the default context on sanity-check failure, and its successful path registers guarded destruction/nulling at xpcom-shutdown. Registration follows awaited key loading, so this does not establish cleanup for all earlier initialization errors. No native destructor, shutdown race or ASan result was exercised.
title: RNPLib adds failure and shutdown destruction for its native contexts
